title: catalyst module list|verify
description: What `catalyst module list --json` and `catalyst module verify --json` print: each installed or recorded module against the criterion's record of it (`GET /v1/modules` returns the same list under `modules`, local mode).

state.description: `ok`: its tree matches the record; `changed`: a file under it changed outside `catalyst sync`; `unrecorded`: installed before the record existed; `missing`: recorded, its folder gone.

source.description: Where it was installed from: a directory, a release zip or a git URL.

sha256.description: The recorded hash of its tree.

actual.description: The hash recomputed, when it differs from the record.
